description: LTG 600 Apple Certified Lightning Cable 1.2 Meter The boAt LTG 600 cable is compatible with any lightning device that relies on this type of charging style. It connects to Apple iPhones, iPad, and iPod devices, and offers power delivery charging at 3A with fast data sync. It fully supports fast data sync and battery re-charging for any lightning device including standard charging for iPhone 7 and older. There’s no need to wrap, the cable design makes them tangle-free with durability. Metal braided heavy-duty data cable skin design is stress and stretch resistant. *These boAt Lightning Cable images are for illustration purposes only. Actual image may vary.
